through_line.name: la trompe d'Eustache
through_line.progression: teasee en bloc un (le badge diagramme surgit pres de l'oreille) -> ouverte et fonctionnelle en bloc deux (l'air circule, les liquides s'ecoulent) -> gonflee, bouchee et envahie de bacteries en bloc trois -> comparee en bloc quatre (courte et horizontale chez l'enfant contre longue et inclinee chez l'adulte)
through_line.resolution: le bloc final resout le mystere du hook : la geometrie du tube explique pourquoi les enfants sont touches, et le badge comparatif referme la question ouverte au bloc un

blocks.vo_line: Huit enfants sur dix font une otite. Et non, la piscine n'y est pour rien : le vrai coupable se cache au fond de ton oreille, juste derrière le tympan.
blocks.through_line_state: teasee : le badge diagramme de la trompe surgit pres de l'oreille du personnage et revele ou se cache le coupable
shots: WIDE static establishing: the pastel pool; ten soft pink inflatable rings bob on the water in two rows, then eight of them flip belly-up one after another, each landing with a little splash
MEDIUM low angle: the young person stands at the pool edge mid-shrug, droplets dripping; a big pastel lavender X snaps into place over the pool behind them
CLOSE-UP: the young person tilts their head sideways and cups a hand to their ear; tiny water droplets shake out and scatter with soft plips
EXTREME CLOSE-UP slow push-in: the side of their ear; the ear canal opening glows softly from inside, pulsing twice
MEDIUM: the rounded ear-diagram badge swings in from the right and settles beside the young person's head with a bounce; their eyes go wide

blocks.vo_line: Ton oreille abrite une petite pièce reliée à ta gorge par un tunnel minuscule : la trompe d'Eustache. Sa mission : aérer cette cavité et évacuer les liquides en continu.
blocks.through_line_state: ouverte et saine : le tube s'illumine, l'air circule vers la cavite et les liquides glissent vers la gorge
shots: WIDE static establishing: the middle-ear chamber; the pale eardrum membrane shivers gently, then the slim mint tube lights up section by section down toward the throat opening
MEDIUM lateral with a gentle drift right: baby blue air sparkles stream up the tube one after another and pop softly against the membrane
CLOSE-UP high angle: the tube entrance at the cavity floor; a single droplet rolls in, then slides away down the slope and plops out of sight
EXTREME CLOSE-UP slow push-in: the membrane surface flexes in and out like a calm breath as two sparkles arrive and burst
MEDIUM low angle down the tube's length: three droplets queue at the top, then whoosh away one after another toward the throat opening

blocks.vo_line: Attrape un rhume, et ce tunnel gonfle puis se bouche : du liquide s'accumule derrière le tympan. Les bactéries adorent cette piscine tiède : elles s'y multiplient, et voilà l'otite.
blocks.through_line_state: bouchee : les parois gonflent et se ferment, le liquide s'accumule dans la cavite et les bacteries s'y multiplient
shots: CLOSE-UP static: the pink tissue box pops in beside the tube entrance and one tissue whips out; the tube's walls puff up and squeeze shut with a squelch
MEDIUM high angle with a slow tilt down: baby blue liquid rises step by step behind the membrane, flooding the cavity floor
EXTREME CLOSE-UP: the liquid surface; three round germ blobs surface one after another - pink, then mint, then lavender - the last one popping up with a splash
MEDIUM: the germ blobs each clap their stubby arms and split into two, then those split again, crowding the warm pool shoulder to shoulder
CLOSE-UP low angle from inside: the membrane now bulges outward slightly, blob silhouettes pressed against it as it throbs twice

blocks.vo_line: Mais pourquoi surtout les enfants ? Leur trompe est plus courte et presque horizontale, alors le liquide stagne au chaud — abonne-toi, demain on t'explique pourquoi tu as le hoquet.
blocks.through_line_state: comparee et resolue : trompe courte et horizontale a gauche ou tout stagne, longue et inclinee a droite ou tout s'ecoule — le mystere du hook est paye
shots: WIDE static establishing: the pastel study corner; the rounded comparison board swings up and stamps into place on its stand
EXTREME CLOSE-UP straight on the left panel: the short almost-horizontal tube; a droplet enters and just sits there, wobbling in place without draining
CLOSE-UP lateral on the right panel: the long steeply slanted tube; a droplet zips down its slope and out with a whoosh
MEDIUM: the young person slides in beside the board, taps the short tube twice with one finger, then nods knowingly to camera
CLOSE-UP low angle: the young person points at the viewer, a rounded bell shape pops in beside them and rings with two sparkles, and they wink
